name: job-fair-monitoring-system
description: Job Fair Monitoring System - Unified tracking for JFA issuance, document compliance, job fair reports, and monitoring timelines. Replaces 4 Excel workbooks (34 sheets) with a PostgreSQL-backed Electron desktop application.

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: psql -U postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS job_fair_monitoring;" && npm run db:setup
